note.label: We Are Born in Babylon

precepts.why:
Haggai brings the word to Zerubbabel the governor and Joshua the high priest: “This people say, The time is not come, the time that the Lord’s house should be built.” Why were they saying that? First Esdras shows what was happening: “But the heathen of the land lying heavy upon the inhabitants of Judea, and holding them strait, hindered their building”.

They were hindering the building of the temple. “And by their secret plots, and popular persuasions and commotions, they hindered the finishing of the building all the time that king Cyrus lived: so they were hindered from building for the space of two years, until the reign of Darius.” See that: secret plots, persuading the multitude to go against us, causing commotions.

So everybody was discouraged, with all the other nations hindering them, and they said, maybe this is not the time for the temple to be built. Zerubbabel and Joshua stopped building. Then God raised up Haggai and Zechariah to blast the high priest and the governor so they would go back to the work, and they finished it in the sixth year of the reign of Darius.

That is why it is important to read your four chapters a day. Captains, make sure your soldiers are reading, so they graduate properly at the end of the year having read the whole Bible; then you know the history behind a verse like Haggai 1:2. And the lesson stands for us: the enemy's plots are no reason to let the Lord's house lie waste while we dwell in our cieled houses.

note.label: All Skinfolk Ain't Kinfolk: Children of Darkness

precepts.why:
“Now when the adversaries of Judah and Benjamin heard that the children of the captivity builded the temple unto the Lord God of Israel”, these heathen, placed in the land in the time of Assyria, came and said, “Let us build with you: for we seek your God, as ye do”. We want to serve God, we want to be around you, we want to cleave. But at that time we were back from exile and not ruling; we were under Persian subjugation.

1 Esdras gives the answer: “It is not for us and you to build together an house unto the Lord our God. We ourselves alone will build unto the Lord of Israel”. We ourselves alone. We don't need your help. Our forefathers understood that in captivity solidarity and unity were paramount. Yet today, as this truth grows and is harder to blackball, there are Israelites with a house negro spirit trying to find a place in our salvation for our enemies, whose heaven is our hell. That is post-traumatic slave disorder, and it is pushing the same agenda into the truth.

Because they were told no, “the heathen of the land lying heavy upon the inhabitants of Judea, and holding them strait, hindered their building”. You know how Esau gets when he is told no: he turns into a different beast. It is the same when black folks built for themselves: Black Wall Street, Rosewood, Tulsa, Seneca Village, Black Bottom in Detroit, Lake Lanier. Whenever we build, they come along wanting in, and then destroy it.

“And by their secret plots, and popular persuasions and commotions, they hindered the finishing of the building”. Secret plots are the laws they passed: redlining, blackballing, Jim Crow, systematic laws to make sure black folks don't thrive again, because left to ourselves we rebuild. Segregation was the best thing for us; integration in captivity destroyed us. Popular persuasions today are Christianity, social media, politics, philosophies, New Year's Eve, Christmas, Halloween, Easter, Islam, money, podcasters and content creators.

“so they were hindered from building for the space of two years, until the reign of Darius.” Their plan was never to join us. If they really believed in helping, why go through all this to stop the building? Their plan was to join, infiltrate and destroy from the inside, like the Black Panthers: first the feminist and lesbian black women were let in, and a feminist-minded black woman is the white man with breasts and melanin, the white man's drone; then the white folks came in, and it was a wrap. Martin King found at the end that he had integrated his people into a burning house. That is why our fathers said, we ourselves alone will build.

The pattern holds in our history: in exile in Europe we taught Esau our laws, and he destroyed us and became us; in Africa we taught the Arab, and he enslaved us. When you are in exile, you do not share your wisdom with the nations. The time is to keep the commandments of God and the faith of his Son, gain favour with our God, and get out of this condition, then deal with the nations after that.

precepts.text: Israel dwelt as strangers away from their own land, showing what a stranger is.
precepts.point: The stranger here is not another nation. A stranger is an Israelite living out of his own tribe's land; if you are of Judah and you sojourn in Benjamin, you are counted a stranger. Christianity uses this verse to claim the other nations dwell among Israel and receive the land, but that is not what is being said.

note.label: Ezekiel 47: The Waters Issuing from the House

precepts.why:
“And these are they of Jewry that came up from the captivity, where they dwelt as strangers, whom Nabuchodonosor the king of Babylon had carried away unto Babylon.” Israel dwelt as strangers in Babylon, away from their own land. That is what a stranger is: an Israelite living out of his own land.

So the stranger that sojourns among you and begets children, counted “as born in the country among the children of Israel” and given inheritance in the tribe where he sojourns, is an Israelite out of his own tribe's land. Of Judah, sojourning in Benjamin, you are the stranger. It is not another nation receiving the land, whatever Christianity claims from this verse.

note.label: 1 Esdras 5: The Return From the Captivity and the Foundation Laid

points: In the second year and second month after his coming to the temple of God at Jerusalem, Zorobabel and Jesus and their brethren laid the foundation of the house of God.

note.label: 1 Esdras 5: The Return From the Captivity and the Foundation Laid

points: The priests stood arrayed in their vestments with musical instruments and trumpets, and the Levites the sons of Asaph had cymbals, singing songs of thanksgiving and praising the Lord, according as David the king of Israel had ordained.

note.label: 1 Esdras 5: The Return From the Captivity and the Foundation Laid

points: The ancients that had seen the former house came to the building of this with weeping and great crying, and the trumpets might not be heard for the weeping of the people; yet the multitude sounded marvellously, so that it was heard afar off.

note.label: 1 Esdras 5: The Return From the Captivity and the Foundation Laid

points: The enemies of the tribe of Judah and Benjamin came to know what the noise of the trumpets should mean, and perceived that they of the captivity did build the temple unto the Lord God of Israel.

note.label: 1 Esdras 5: The Return From the Captivity and the Foundation Laid

points: They said, We will build together with you, for likewise as ye do we obey your Lord, and do sacrifice unto him from the days of Azbazareth the king of the Assyrians.

points: Zorobabel and Jesus and the chief of the families of Israel said unto them, It is not for us and you to build together an house unto the Lord our God; we ourselves alone will build unto the Lord of Israel, according as Cyrus the king of the Persians hath commanded us.

note.label: 1 Esdras 5: The Return From the Captivity and the Foundation Laid

points: But the heathen of the land, lying heavy upon the inhabitants of Judea, and holding them strait, hindered their building; and by their secret plots and popular persuasions and commotions they hindered the finishing of the building all the time that king Cyrus lived, so that they were hindered from building for the space of two years, until the reign of Darius.

points: You’ve seen the increased security, and there is a reason for it. “But the heathen of the land lying heavy upon the inhabitants of Judea, and holding them strait, hindered their building”; “And by their secret plots, and popular persuasions and commotions, they hindered the finishing of the building”: when you read the scriptures, it is reminiscent of the turbulent 60s and 70s under COINTELPRO, when they pitted black groups against one another and sent false correspondence to cause confusion and division. This is the second time law enforcement has asked someone who got arrested to inform or plant something in our congregations. They are looking for men and women to plant things on us to try to shut us down. That is why, when you brothers do the deep clean, check under the chairs, check everything. You all know each other, but you really don’t know what’s going on behind the scenes. Come a little early for the search.
